svg.title: MOKS component architecture
svg.desc: The API, or an alert, queues an investigation in PostgreSQL. The worker claims it and runs a LangGraph StateGraph whose nodes call Investigator methods. Model calls pass through MoksChatModel and budget.complete to a provider. Tool calls reach the ToolExecutor, which calls connectors and kb_search and stores evidence and audit records in PostgreSQL. Write access exists only in the separate moks-executor process, which runs approved action plans and which the graph cannot reach.
